exercises.instruction: MARK THE SENTENCES THAT ARE CORRECT

items.question: Pedro is really good at history. / Pedro really good is at history.
items.correct_answer: Pedro is really good at history.

items.question: You speak really well French. / You speak French really well.
Sandra is very good at singing. / Sandra very good is at singing.
items.correct_answer: Sandra is very good at singing.

items.question: Sal is at skiing quite good. / Sal is quite good at skiing.
items.correct_answer: Sal is quite good at skiing.

items.question: Very well your uncle can swim. / Your uncle can swim very well.
items.correct_answer: Your uncle can swim very well.

items.question: They quite fast can run. / They can run quite fast.
Mr. Henderson is really good at golf. / At golf Mr. Henderson is really good.
items.correct_answer: Mr. Henderson is really good at golf.

exercises.instruction: REWRITE THE SENTENCES, PUTTING THE WORDS IN THE CORRECT ORDER

items.question: isn't / at / very / art and design. / good / Arnold
items.correct_answer: Arnold isn't very good at art and design.

items.question: is / English. / speaking / really / cousin / good / at / My
items.correct_answer: My cousin is really good at speaking English.

items.question: is / at / climbing / Jean / quite / mountains. / good
items.correct_answer: Jean is quite good at climbing mountains.
